_note: Giant kelp, 1.8 to 2.4 m tall: a holdfast of seven root-like haptera knotted on the sand, three tapering six-sided stipes rising from it, each in five segments; two long ribbed blades a segment lean out and up from round gas bladders, on alternate sides, longer toward the top. The stipes sway in the current, more toward the top (sway, 4.8 s round). Written by tools/models/scenery.py.
name: Kelp
